items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Just like Bobbie Hackett, they seemed to be the same type of guys you know -- in the way that they were trained

ctx.x: For instance the way you use the plunger is pretty unique I think. When did you start doing that?

Oh, I've been doing that for years. I used to hear bands from way back -- well one band in particular was Duke Ellington's band. No, Fletch Henderson too had a plunger player -- he had Joe Smith who played plunger but

he played sweet horn. He was one of my idols. Just like Bobbie Hackett, they seemed to be the same type of guys you know -- in the way that they were trained -- the solos they played. You know -- they played pretty, you know. And I liked Joe Smith very much.
